Name: Urijah, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Urijah, son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, prophesied against Jerusalem and the land in words like Jeremiah's. Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt, seized him, brought him back, and killed him with the sword, casting his body into the graves of the common people. He is a different man from Uriah the priest of Isaiah's day.
KeyStory: Urijah prophesied against the city, fled to Egypt when Jehoiakim sought his life, was fetched back by Elnathan, and was slain by the king.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Ahikam; Jeremiah; Elnathan
LifeLesson: A true prophet's death does not disprove his message — Ahikam's protection of Jeremiah proved the court knew it.
